title: Resolvent Degree of the General Degree-Seven Polynomial (Algebraic Form of Hilbert's Thirteenth Problem)
exact_target: Does solving the generic degree-seven polynomial necessarily require algebraic functions of at least three independent variables, even when finite towers of such functions are allowed?

sources.citation: A. G. Vitushkin, "On Hilbert's thirteenth problem and related questions", Russian Mathematical Surveys 59 (2004), no. 1; DOI 10.1070/RM2004v059n01ABEH000698.
